column1: # W47: operating-point calibration for the UI-TARS-1.5-7B single-step ladder.
# Why. The 42-cell wide grid (scripts/xds_jobs/w47_uitars_wide.tsv) ran the TRACE
# arm at one fixed operating point: prior strength alpha = 2.0 and the DEFAULT
# current-frame coverage dose (GEOPACT_CRS_SKEL_FRAC unset, i.e. rho_cov = 0.10).
# That is the 8B-adopted setting, not a calibrated one. On six of the twelve
# suite x budget cells the fixed point trails the strongest baseline by 0.6 to
# prior cap and the coverage dose per benchmark-budget grid point from a declared
# public grid. This wave applies the SAME protocol to the failing cells rather
# than reporting one transplanted 8B operating point as if it were tuned. The
# already-leading six cells are not re-run, so their published numbers stay the
# Grid. Three arms per failing cell, all inside the declared grids:
# Everything else is byte-identical to the wide TRACE rows, so the only variables
# are the two calibrated ones. MMBench-GUI L2 is the weakest suite for the layout
# prior, which is why it gets the full four-budget sweep.
# 6 failing cells x 3 arms = 18 cells. Launch the same TSV on every free GPU: the
# per-OUT mkdir claim in _xds_gpu_queue.sh distributes the cells and prevents two
# queues from entering the same run dir.
